title: Attacker can manipulate the protocols AUM
summary: ## Severity  **Impact:** High  **Likelihood:** High  ## Description  In the new design, the AUM value will be set and updated by off-chain bot. The issue is that the bot defines the absolute value of the AUM and the Fyde contract changes the current AUM based on the bot-provided value so the attacker can change the current AUM by front-running and causing the wrong AUM value when the bot's transaction executes.
